user.title: Configure Smart Bulb Management
user.description: Link a Leviton switch or dimmer (with Smart Bulb Mode enabled) to smart bulbs without interfering with ha-holiday-lighting.

data.holiday_control_entity: Holiday Lighting Switch/Boolean to pause on Off (optional)
data.pause_holiday_on_off: Turn off Holiday Lighting control entity when switch turns Off
data.two_way_sync: Two-way sync (bulbs update switch state passively)
data.override_holiday: Override holiday lighting when switch turns On
data.color_mode: Default color mode when switch turns On (if holiday lighting is not On)

reconfigure.title: Change the switch or dimmer
reconfigure.description: Choose the switch or dimmer (in Smart Bulb Mode) that controls these bulbs. The bulbs and other settings stay the same.

data.holiday_control_entity: Holiday Lighting Switch/Boolean to pause on Off (optional)
data.pause_holiday_on_off: Turn off Holiday Lighting control entity when switch turns Off
data.two_way_sync: Two-way sync (bulbs update switch state passively)
data.override_holiday: Override holiday lighting when switch turns On
data.color_mode: Default color mode when switch turns On (if holiday lighting is not On)

switch_missing.title: {title}: switch no longer exists
switch_missing.description:
Smart Bulb Management can't find the switch or dimmer `{entity}` for **{title}**, so the bulbs won't follow it. It may have been deleted or renamed.

Go to **Settings > Devices & services > Smart Bulb Management**, open **{title}**, and choose **Reconfigure** to pick the switch again. This message goes away once the switch is back.

bulbs_missing.title: {title}: bulbs no longer exist
bulbs_missing.description:
Smart Bulb Management can't find these bulbs for **{title}**: {entities}. They may have been deleted or renamed.

Go to **Settings > Devices & services > Smart Bulb Management**, open **{title}**, choose **Configure**, and update **Target Smart Bulbs**. This message goes away once the bulbs are back or removed from the list.
